samples.copilotQuestion: 查询 202606 账期 1001 项目 结算2026060008 的月对账三级金额明细

copilotRequest.nativeSql: SELECT '结算2026060008' AS "businessKey", CAST(m.project_id AS VARCHAR) AS "projectId", REPLACE(COALESCE(m.year_and_month, CONCAT(CAST(m.settlement_year AS VARCHAR), LPAD(CAST(m.settlement_month AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'))), '-', '') AS "accountPeriod", CAST(NULLIF(CAST(m.receivable_total_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS "receivableTotalAmount", CAST(NULLIF(CAST(m.net_receipt_total_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS "netReceiptTotalAmount", CAST(NULLIF(CAST(m.folding_after_total_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS "foldingAfterTotalAmount", CAST(NULLIF(CAST(m.total_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS "totalAmount" FROM public.ods_ptr_mysql_a_month_accounting m WHERE CAST(m.project_id AS VARCHAR) = '1001' AND REPLACE(COALESCE(m.year_and_month, CONCAT(CAST(m.settlement_year AS VARCHAR), LPAD(CAST(m.settlement_month AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'))), '-', '') = '202606' ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1

samples.copilotQuestion: 查询 202606 账期 1001 项目 BX202606030968 的售账应收实收明细

copilotRequest.nativeSql: SELECT b.code AS "businessKey", CAST(b.project_id AS VARCHAR) AS "projectId", '202606' AS "accountPeriod", CAST(NULLIF(CAST(a.receivable_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS "receivableAmount", CAST(NULLIF(CAST(a.net_receipts_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS "netReceiptsAmount", CAST(NULLIF(CAST(a.biz_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS "bizAmount" FROM public.ods_ptr_mysql_a_sale_account a JOIN public.ods_ptr_mysql_t_flower_biz_info b ON CAST(a.biz_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(b.id AS VARCHAR) WHERE b.code = 'BX202606030968' AND CAST(b.project_id AS VARCHAR) = '1001' LIMIT 1
